steps.label: 3289-own-paper1094-real-pointer-cancel-open
command: (async()=>{const f=document.querySelector('#paperModifyForm'),m=document.querySelector('#cancelConfirmModal');if(f?.elements.paperId.value!=='1094'||[...f.querySelectorAll('[name=itemIds]')].map(e=>e.value).join(',')!=='2089238,2089242,2089243,2089244,2089245'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own local reordered form required');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Cancel shown timeout')),10000);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});f.querySelector('a[data-confirm-cancel]').click();await shown;return {shown:true,text:m.innerText};})()
